_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'ADMINISTRATIVE AND RESOURCE RELEASE FORM' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-07.07.

f01_Resource_Release_Scope_and_Demobiliz.label: Resource Release Scope and Demobilization Schedule
f01_Resource_Release_Scope_and_Demobiliz.guidance: Staff members, contractors, and specialized consultants slated for scheduled release back to functional pools.

f02_Equipment_Hardware_and_Physical_Asse.label: Equipment Hardware and Physical Asset Return Log
f02_Equipment_Hardware_and_Physical_Asse.guidance: Inventory of laptops, test devices, security tokens, and field equipment inspected and returned.

f03_IT_Access_Revocation_and_Account_Dep.label: IT Access Revocation and Account Deprovisioning
f03_IT_Access_Revocation_and_Account_Dep.guidance: Revocation of VPN credentials, code repository commit access, cloud IAM roles, and facility badge access.

f04_Financial_Cost_Center_Closure_and_In.label: Financial Cost Center Closure and Invoice Clearance
f04_Financial_Cost_Center_Closure_and_In.guidance: Reconciliation of expense reports, settlement of pending vendor invoices, and freezing project cost centers.

f05_HR_and_Functional_Manager_Demobiliza.label: HR and Functional Manager Demobilization Signoff
f05_HR_and_Functional_Manager_Demobiliza.guidance: Joint sign-off between Project Manager, HR, and Functional Manager releasing resource obligations.
